typography.systemNote: the Short App type system is INTER-ONLY (all 24 text styles; there is no mono register in this design system)
typography.dataRule: tabular-nums (the Short App system is Inter-only; no mono register exists — if the Figma appears to show a mono face, flag it as a design question rather than importing a font the token set doesn't define)

audience: applicant-facing (the Short App application flow — fields, cards, actions) or portal/reviewer-facing (the Portal Specific set: StatusTracker, Action, UtilityButton). This selects which component families apply.

briefSchema.heading: Flow
briefSchema.hint: consumer | business | auto-loan

briefSchema.heading: Step position
briefSchema.hint: STEP n OF m · SECTION NAME (or "unknown — asked")

briefSchema.heading: User
briefSchema.hint: who, in one sentence

briefSchema.heading: Job to be done
briefSchema.hint: the applicant's goal on this step

briefSchema.heading: Entry point
briefSchema.hint: which step / link leads here

briefSchema.heading: Data displayed
briefSchema.hint: | item | source |

briefSchema.heading: Data collected
briefSchema.hint: | field | type | required | format / placeholder | options source | — required-ness stated for EVERY field, including fields inside a conditional block

briefSchema.heading: Actions & consequences
briefSchema.hint: | control | verb | result | destination |

briefSchema.heading: States
briefSchema.hint: | state (empty / disabled / error / success / …) | trigger | what shows |

briefSchema.heading: Conditional logic
briefSchema.hint: | trigger | exact boundary rule | what reveals | required-ness of the revealed fields | — "less than 2 years" needs its arithmetic, not its phrase

briefSchema.heading: Validation rules
briefSchema.hint: | field | rule | message shown | when it fires | — every rule needs its message; a rule with no message is a copy gap

briefSchema.heading: Copy supplied
briefSchema.hint: | id | role | text | — list EVERY role explicitly or mark it "not supplied": title · description · field labels · placeholders (per shaped field) · sub-section labels · help text · button labels · error messages · empty-state text · legal/consent

stopTriggers.when: the step is none of the eight §2 archetypes (a table, a dashboard tile, a file upload…)

a progress bar or back control in the header, a sidebar/rail/tab strip, NEXT, an asterisk for required, a second typeface or monospace, a gray disabled primary, an overlay for detail, a confirmation page (§7 hands off to the portal)
loading state, conditional-reveal indent value, progress-bar track colour, roles-matrix label type, owner-row height on mobile
legal / consent copy is missing (never drafted)

conceptSections: Step position + eyebrow text — STEP n OF m / SECTION
Mobile behaviour per §1.2 — what stacks, what stays three-up, the sticky footer

viewports.note: 1920 canvas, 720 column at x 600 (§1) — web only; mobile is out of scope for v1 (§13.1)

briefSchema.heading: Archetype
briefSchema.hint: hub | section-index | application-detail | record-detail | task-flow (the §2 row)

briefSchema.heading: User
briefSchema.hint: who, in one sentence — a signed-in member, not an applicant

briefSchema.heading: Job to be done
briefSchema.hint: what the member came to this page to find out or finish

briefSchema.heading: Entry point
briefSchema.hint: which nav tab, section link, or to-do row leads here

briefSchema.heading: Sections & order
briefSchema.hint: | section label | what it holds | why it sits there | — ordered by what blocks the member first (§3); finished groups last

briefSchema.heading: Section counters
briefSchema.hint: | section | counter or link | — every section label needs its right-hand partner (§3): a fraction like "1 of 4 verified" or a link like "All Applications ›"

briefSchema.heading: Data displayed
briefSchema.hint: | item | source | format | — the portal is mostly read; masked ids use the bullet form (§8)

briefSchema.heading: Data collected
briefSchema.hint: | field | type | required | format / placeholder | options source | — task-flow only; mark "none" for the other four archetypes

briefSchema.heading: Actions & consequences
briefSchema.hint: | control | verb | result | destination | — one action per row plus at most one link (§5); name which single control, if any, is the commit

briefSchema.heading: Status vocabulary
briefSchema.hint: | state | which of the three forms (§6): row-level 12/16 · emphatic eyebrow UPPER · task chip micro-label | colour | — every status is a word; colour is added to the word

briefSchema.heading: States
briefSchema.hint: | state (empty / blocked / done / error / …) | trigger | what shows | — empty renders as a to-do row, never a blank (§6)

briefSchema.heading: Blocked-on
briefSchema.hint: | item | person | artifact | — a blocked item names the person and the thing (§6); say "none" if nothing blocks

briefSchema.heading: Copy supplied
briefSchema.hint: | id | role | text | — list EVERY role explicitly or mark it "not supplied": title · subtitle · meta · section labels · counters · row titles · descriptions · button labels · status words · empty-state text · legal/consent

stopTriggers.when: the page is none of the five §2 archetypes (a table, a settings form, a chart, a wizard…)

a STEP n OF m eyebrow, a progress bar used as sequence position, a Back/Continue footer row, the 560 column, a .va-btn family control for an inline action, an uppercase button label, a table or column-headed grid, a sidebar/breadcrumb/sub-nav, monospace, a shadow on a card, a rule between rows inside a card, a filled button that is not a commit, or a bare number without its unit or denominator
quick-action button height, nav-tab height, header stickiness, loading or error/validation states, post-commit success
legal / consent copy is missing (never drafted), or a section label has no counter or link partner

conceptSections: Section order — what blocks the member first (§3), and each label's counter or link partner
Status vocabulary — which of the three §6 forms each state uses, and its token
